card.name: Print and copy after book-format words
card.fires_on: The words "print" or "copy" right after a modifier like fine, hard, large, new or presentation, in talk of printed text or copies of a work.

modes.label: fine/large print
modes.description: "print" after fine or large, meaning small type or print format.

modes.label: hard/new copy
modes.description: "copy" after hard, new, this, presentation or artificial, meaning a physical or duplicate version.
modes.example: originally printed in fifteen hard<<copy>> volumes.

card.plain: It fires on the second word of phrases like "fine print" and "hard copy".
